name: Girl
source:
She is the eldest daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c77256]Seiji[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c77259]Atsu[/url], as she is 20 years after Seiji's return to town.

She and her [url=https://vndb.org/c77261]younger brother[/url] discover the secret base of their parents, the place where their relationship of childhood friends has become a loving relationship.
